desc:
The Official KPop Demon Hunters Roblox game, brought to you by Netflix and Twin Atlas!

Join HUNTR/X in an action-packed experience where music and combat collide.
Build your KPop Idol, protect the fans and save the Honmoon.
Unlock fresh fits, new gear, apartment customizations and pets along your journey as you fight demons.

Live out your dream life as a KPop star!
